title: Naayak
desc: Siddharth and Charan, two lookalikes who are fighting their own battles against evildoers, cross paths and join forces to take down Rawat, a ruthless minister.

title: Varushamellam Vasantham
desc: Raja, a jobless youth, and his well-educated cousin, Ramesh, fall in love with Latha, a distant relative. The two brothers compete against each other to win over her love.

title: Paatti Sollai Thattathe
desc: A man leaves his home after marrying a woman his family disliked. However, when he gets an opportunity to restore their relationship, he ruins it by trying to pass someone else's baby as his own.

title: Thendral
desc: A young girl grows up harbouring a crush for her favourite writer. However, things get complicated when they both meet and she ends up getting pregnant.

title: Samsaram Adhu Minsaram
desc: A dutiful father, Ammaiyappan Mudaliar, does not leave any wish unfulfilled of his four kids. But soon, his eldest son causes disruption and discontent within the family.
